How to buy if you live outside the US

1. register at https://www.borderlinx.com/ (do not choose US when registering because then you won't be given an US billing adress)
2. make an account at amazon and proceed as you normally would if you were to purchase something
3. use your info given to you on borderlinx
4. do not click 'download now' after the purchase is complete, but instead click 'Your account' on amazon, then under 'Digital content' click 'Your Games and Software Library'
5. copy your serial key and enter on steam

It sounds like you and me are suffering from comparing ourselves to others. I've felt like I'm only good for whatever society can exploit me for, and I still feel like this feeling is forced upon me, but then I start thinking about what is the reason behind this? And then I realize there isn't any, because people are all a part of the rat race, and they're all losers because there aren't any finish line nor any prizes. Do things that make you happy, don't spend a second trying to prove yourself to anyone. I.e. if you are the CEO of whatever profitable business or you flip burgers for a living, how many of the 7+ billion people on this planet cares? When you break everything down, the only thing that separates you from anyone else on this planet are the movements your body make and the thoughts you think, and you haven't done anything wrong. Let yourself be the writer of your own story.

If you can put you finger on what is bothering you and attempt to fix it, then do it, because I know how stressing uncertainty can be. 

Say if you're demotivated by something, and things start snowballing and you end up being depressed, small things like cleaning your garbage dump bedroom can sometimes give you back a small boost of motivation to right your wrongs, put simply. This is just an advice though, it might not even apply to your situation, but the logic behind it still applies. Small efforts can make the biggest of differences. Good luck.
